## Key facts

## Facilities
- Playgroup (2–3 yrs)
- Pre-KG (3–4 yrs)
- Junior KG (4–5 yrs)
- Senior KG (5–6 yrs)

- Life skills & moral education

- CCTV
- School bus

## Frequently asked questions

### Where is A2 Bethel International Academy?
Malar Illam, 3/358, Venkateshwara Nagar, Medavakkam, Chennai 600 100.

### What facilities does A2 Bethel International Academy have?
Playgroup (2–3 yrs), Pre-KG (3–4 yrs), Junior KG (4–5 yrs), Senior KG (5–6 yrs), Integrated Montessori learning, Music & movement, Art & craft, Storytelling & drama, Yoga & physical education, Life skills & moral education, Smart Kid Abacus, CCTV, School bus.

### What ages do you take?
Playgroup from 2 years, Pre-KG at 3, Junior KG at 4 and Senior KG at 5.

### What else do children learn?
Music and movement, art and craft, storytelling and drama, yoga and physical education, and life skills and moral education.

### Where are you?
Two branches: Venkateshwara Nagar, Medavakkam and 1st Main Road, Kovilambakkam.
